title: A Survey on Multimodal Benchmarks: In the Era of Large AI Models

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing benchmarks (such as CorrelationQA and MM-SPUBENCH) that present image-text pairs containing both core and spurious features to evaluate whether models can focus on essential core features while ignoring irrelevant or misleading correlations.

Surveying safety and trustworthiness benchmarks (like RTVLM and MultiTrust) that use red-teaming evaluations and cross-modal impact assessments to test models in adversarial or ethically challenging scenarios for fairness and safety.
